observations.description: Original 3D cartoon animation, not stock footage: recurring round-headed characters with dot eyes and thin limbs in detailed isometric office sets.
Virtual 3D camera moves: push-ins, top-down and low angles, face close-ups; perspective changes rather than flat 2D zooms.

Captions show 1-2 words at a time in sentence case with punctuation kept (e.g. 'Wait,', 'paradise.'); white heavy rounded sans-serif with a thin dark outline and soft shadow, centred just below the middle of the frame. No boxes, no emoji.
Font category: heavy geometric/rounded sans-serif (Poppins/Montserrat-like category). The exact font cannot be identified from the frames.
No overlay graphics, stickers or progress bar; text appears inside the scene (door sign, calendar, FIRE button).
Calendar-page overlay with a crossfade signals time passing.
Bright, saturated cartoon palette (blues/greens); a night skyline marks a time jump.
Hook states a paradox in one sentence, then escalates with concrete consequences; narration runs continuously over constant visual changes.
